description_en: Creates a node to query alerting events triggered by the same rule hits or Alarm Metric
description_zh: 创建任务查询相同规则或告警类型触发的告警事件
name: CreateSimilarSecurityEventsQueryTask

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security alert
parameters.name: security_event_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the alerting event that has the same type or rule hits
parameters.help_zh: 相同类型或命中规则的告警事件的code值
parameters.name: similar_event_scenario_code

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token
